prefsFloor.restIntervalRule: harvestAndFeed (and harvestAndRest with useHpBasedRest=false, which the floor forbids): restInterval >= min(30000, ceil(farmInterval * 51 / 100))
prefsFloor.failsafeRestRule: harvestAndFeed with failsafe on (forced): failsafeRestDuration >= min(72000, max(3600, restInterval))
prefsFloor.hpRule: useHpBasedRest forced on; hpThresholdLow >= 45; hpThresholdHigh >= min(100, hpThresholdLow + 5)

actionsPerDay.formula: rest_v3: cycle = REST_V3_MEASURED_CYCLE_SEC, else cycle = max(60,farm)+max(60,rest); actions = ceil(86400/cycle)*2 + 4; non-rest_v3 adds ceil(86400/collect) + ceil(86400/scavenge) for intervals > 0; harvestAndFeed with a feed timer adds ceil(86400/feedInterval). Computed on FLOORED prefs.

feePerGasFormula.eip1559: max(2 * baseFeePerGas + maxPriorityFeePerGas, gasPrice); maxPriorityFeePerGas = eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas or 1 gwei when the RPC returns none; no base fee -> gasPrice

gas.billedActionGasFormula: units + floor(units / 10)  (Yominet charges 10% of unused gas)
gas.exitRule: ACTIVE lease: strategy stopped when operatorBalance + escrow < exitStopTriggerActions * billedActionWei; restarted at >= exitResumeActions * billedActionWei
gas.setupAndHubRule: price setupGasWei and hubGasWei at the same billed feePerGas

reservations.quoteRule: a quote holds NO capacity: no reservation cap, listing lock, cooldown, attempt counter or quote-held lease slot exists. Each quote still gets its own random operator key, stored durably before reserve/attest answer; nothing counts that store. Contention for one Kami is settled on-chain (factory ActiveRequest / market pending-lease revert), so the web must simulate the checkout (eth_call / estimateGas) before asking the wallet to send, and show that the Kami was just rented when the simulation reverts
reservations.capRule: both caps count ON-CHAIN leases only: unreturned ingested pods plus on-chain pods parked for ingest retry, distinct per listing. Quotes never count. A listing that already has an on-chain lease never trips a cap. Honest concurrent checkouts may overshoot by the quotes issued just under the cap (bounded by listings)
reservations.reservationTtlRule: an unattested operator key can be attested for reservationTtlSec; the keeper signs only quote deadlines in the future and at most reservationTtlSec + 60 s ahead
reservations.reserveBody: { market, factory, nonce, renter, tokenIndex, fundingWei }  -> 201 { operator }  (nonce 0x + 64 hex; tokenIndex optional but should be sent; fundingWei optional decimal string = setupGasWei + hubGasWei + operatingGasWei of the priced quote, should be sent)
reservations.reserveOrder: body checks -> on-chain caps (no RPC) -> balance (only when fundingWei is sent) -> fresh random key -> durable (journal append + fsync) -> answer
reservations.attestBody: { market, factory, quote }  -> 200 { keeperSignature }  (quote.nonce must name a stored reservation of the same renter, quote.operator must be its operator; quote.tokenIndex and quote.deadline required; with requireRenterBalance quote.setupGasWei, hubGasWei and operatingGasWei are required; the listing must exist)
reservations.attestOrder: body checks -> deadline bound -> on-chain caps -> listing exists -> balance -> quoteDigest -> binding durable (journal append + fsync) -> keeper signature
reservations.releaseBody: { market, factory, nonce, renter }  -> 200 { released: boolean }; idempotent; answered even while the worker is stale or halted
reservations.releaseRule: optional hygiene when the renter cancels checkout or the wallet rejects the tx: an unattested key is deleted at once; an attested one is only marked (kept until its deadline has passed on-chain). Frees no capacity (none is held)

refusalScopes.renter: RESERVATION_CAP: this wallet holds maxActiveLeasesPerRenter on-chain leases
refusalScopes.market: LEASE_CAP: the market holds maxActiveLeases on-chain leases

reservations.retryAfterRule: every 503 carries Retry-After: 60; 429s carry none (a cap frees up only when an on-chain lease ends)
reservations.renterBalanceRule: attest: renter ETH balance (latest block) >= quote setupGasWei + hubGasWei + operatingGasWei; reserve: >= fundingWei when sent, checked before any key is generated. RPC failure fails closed (503 BALANCE_UNAVAILABLE). A filter for unfunded requests only: it reserves nothing. An INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE attest deletes the unattested key.
reservations.insufficientBalanceBody: 403 { error, code: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE, scope: renter, requiredWei }
reservations.keyStoreUnavailableBody: 503 { error, code: KEY_STORE_UNAVAILABLE }  (the key could not be made durable; nothing was returned)

operatorKeys.generation: one fresh key per quote nonce: 32 bytes from the OS CSPRNG (node:crypto randomBytes); no seed, no derivation
operatorKeys.durability: reserve: the key is appended to <state>.reservations.journal and fsync'd before the operator address is returned; attest: the quote binding (digest, deadline) is appended and fsync'd before the keeper signature is returned
operatorKeys.store: <state>.reservations.json snapshot { version: 1, generation, reservations } + <state>.reservations.journal (JSON lines); both mode 0600; compacted when the journal outgrows the snapshot, at startup and on SIGTERM
operatorKeys.pruneRule: unattested: after reservationTtlSec; attested: only once ingest has covered a confirmed block whose timestamp is past the quote deadline; never while an event for the nonce is parked for ingest retry; never evicted for space
operatorKeys.ingestRule: on RenterPodCreated the stored key for the event nonce must reproduce the event operator; otherwise the event is parked and [LEASE-ALERT] OPERATOR_MISMATCH is raised. A claimed key moves into the job; it is deleted from the store only after the job state is saved

rules: trim; strip one pair of matching surrounding quotes; trim
split on ','; trim entries; skip empty entries
each entry: 0x + 40 hex digits, any case (no checksum check), else hard error at startup
non-empty value without any address -> hard error
